title: 第十一章 坊市
content_zh:
魔核，在斗气大陆之上，也被称为魔晶，以及灵丹药的雏形等等，顾名思义，这是魔兽体内的一种能量晶核，其内充斥着极为狂暴的天地能量，对于这种狂暴能量，就算是一名斗王，也不敢冒着爆体的危险，将之强行吸入 。
然而魔核虽然并不能直接供人吸收，不过它却是炼药师炼药时必不可缺的主材料，经过炼药师用秘法炼制过的魔核，会被一些神奇的药草中和掉狂暴属性，摇身变为无数人垂涎至极的各种提升实力的灵药，身价顿时暴涨
再有，魔核也能加持在武器之上，被加持了魔核的武器，破坏力不仅将会更胜一筹，而且还具备增幅斗气的诱人特效，深受斗气大陆斗者阶层的追捧 。
当然，除了武器，魔核也能加持在盔甲等等物品之上，给主人带来强悍的防御力，让人在面对危险之时，更多了几分生命的保障 。
如此众多的特效，自然使得魔核当之无愧的成为了斗气大陆最受欢迎的主流材料，不仅斗者，就是连那些尊贵的炼药师，也常常会屈身满世界寻找高等级的魔核，以炼制更高级的丹药 。
在这种潮流的带动之下，大陆之上的魔核，几乎是常年处于供不应求的境地，高等级的魔核只要一出现在拍卖会或者其他之地，利马便将会被人高价收走 。
魔核的昂贵，自然造就出了大批专以捕杀魔兽为生的佣兵团，不过，魔核的获得，却并不是一件容易的事 。
首先，魔兽不仅实力强悍，并且异常狡诈，由于凶狠的本性以及特殊的攻击方式，魔兽往往比同等级的人类强者要强上几分，所以，想要单独猎杀同等级的魔兽，没有过人的实力，很容易偷鸡不成蚀把米 。
其次，并不是所有的魔兽，体内都具有魔核这种能量结晶，这似乎是一种随机的概率，有时候，当一个佣兵团以半个团人员的伤亡击杀了一头魔兽，说不定到头来，却是两手空空，这种事，在斗气大陆，屡见不鲜，并不算稀奇
因此，魔核在斗气大陆上的身价，一直都是久居其上，极为抢手 。
带着薰儿在宽敞的街道上拐了几拐，最后窜进了位于城市偏南的一处中型坊市，这种中型坊市，在乌坦城足有好几个，分别被城市中的三大家族把持，萧炎所来的这处坊市，便是由他们萧家掌控
说是掌控，其实还不如说是维持坊市的秩序与安全，而作为报酬，在坊市中摆摊交易的佣兵或者商人，就得向家族缴纳一些佣金，这都是斗气大陆一直以来的规矩，倒也很少见到什么人来犯浑捣乱 。
从坊市大门进入，门口处，还有两名萧家的护卫，他们显然也是认识萧炎二人，瞧得他们的到来，都是一愣，旋即略微恭身 。
微微点头，萧炎径直走进，站在大门边，望着里面那川流不息的人流，忍不住的咂了咂嘴，难怪家族对坊市的掌管比较严格，以这种人气所带来的利润，恐怕不会小
“三少爷，薰儿小姐，您们来坊市，是想购买点什么吗”就在两人被人流晃得有些眼花的时候，恭敬的声音，从身后传来 。
听着声音，萧炎回转过头，七八名身着萧家统一服饰的大汉，正站立身后，而说话者，则是领头一位三十岁左右的壮年男子，男子胸口配有一道徽章，徽章上，绘着六颗金星，显然，他是一名六星斗者 。
瞧着萧炎疑惑的视线，男子憨厚一笑，恭声道：“三少爷，我叫佩恩，是族长大人亲自任命的护卫队长，专门护卫坊市的安全，呵呵，少爷去年过生日，佩恩还来见过”
“哦，原来是佩恩大叔啊。”
萧炎眨巴了一下眼睛，虽然对这位大汉没什么印象，不过刚才他的介绍语，却是让得萧炎小脸上扬起了笑容，既然是父亲亲自任命的，那么自然是他的直系属下，忠诚度，应该不会有什么问题 。
萧家虽然并不是什么超级大势力，不过家族中，却也同样分为几派，如果面前的大汉是另外几位长老派系的人，那他也懒得理会，随意敷衍便是了事 。

“在族中待得无聊，所以出来逛逛，佩恩大叔你去忙你的吧，如果有事，我叫你便是。”萧炎稚嫩的声音，并没有少爷的骄横，反而客气温和，让人闻之心情舒畅 。
一声大叔敬称，让得佩恩脸上的笑容顿时浓了几分，同时也更热切了一些，捎了捎脑袋，点头笑道：“那三少爷便随意逛吧，坊市中到处都有我们的人，如果有事，喊一声就行。”
礼貌的点了点头，萧炎拉着薰儿，钻进人流之中，然后消失
“帕里，带两个人跟着三少爷，警告一下坊市中的那些金手指，谁要是敢把主意打到三少爷与薰儿小姐身上，以后就不要在这里混了。”望着消失的少年与少女，佩恩回头轻喝道，脸庞上的憨厚，也是在瞬间化为精干 。
“是，队长”一名大汉沉声点头，手一挥，带着两名汉子混入了人流 。
“呵呵，三少爷待人还是这般温和，真是让人舒坦”望着汇入人流的三人，佩恩笑了笑，旋即惋惜的叹道：“这么好的少年，可惜，唉”
遗憾的摇了摇头，佩恩也是带着手下，巡街去了
慵懒的跟在随意闲逛的萧炎身后，薰儿不着痕迹的瞟了一眼后面的人流，淡淡的微笑道：“萧炎哥哥，那佩恩还不错。”
萧炎轻嗯了一声，目光在身旁一位摊贩中扫了扫，他的灵魂感知力较之常人强上许多，所以后面跟来的护卫，他也知晓得清清楚楚，收回目光，萧炎放缓速度，和身旁的少女并排而行，嗅了嗅那如青莲般清雅的少女体香，偏头戏谑道：“九段斗之气，却能感应到三名精通隐匿的护卫，薰儿，很不一般嘛”
薰儿学着萧炎的模样，可爱的耸了耸肩，再次拿出杀手锏：微笑，沉默
凝望着少女闭口不语的模样，萧炎唇边泛起温醇的笑意，手掌轻轻拍了拍少女的小脑袋，用只能两人听见的声音，低声笑道：“虽然并不清楚你究竟是何身份，有何背景，不过，我只知道，你是我萧炎的妹妹，不管日后如何，步加快，向前行去 。
脚步顿住，薰儿扑扇着美丽的灵动大眼睛，盯着那说完话后，便是潇洒前走的少年，在原地愣了好半晌，薰儿终于是回过了神，嘴角的柔和笑意逐渐扩大，最后将那张精致小脸渲染得极具诱魅 。
人流冲冲的坊市之中，少女立足轻笑，清雅的身姿，恍若俗世青莲，清雅淡然
“妹妹吗薰儿可是很贪心的女孩子呢”偏着小脑袋，薰儿轻轻呢喃了一声，旋即抿嘴淡笑，莲步微移，跟上了前面的悠闲少年 。
跟着萧炎兜兜转转，却是慢慢的进入到了坊市深处，坊市深处售卖之物，较之外面一般要珍贵上许多，所以，能来到此处购买的客户，在乌坦城也算是有几分实力 。
趁着萧炎在埋头苦找魔晶的空档，薰儿也是无聊的来到一处干净的摊贩前，盈盈停下了身子，伸出白皙娇嫩的皓腕，拿起一条淡绿手链，手链材质是普通货，只是加了一些冰银，让人触之冰凉，很适合夏天佩戴，材质虽然普通，不过却也别致清雅
随意把玩了一番，薰儿刚欲购买，却是记起自己早将所有钱借给了萧炎，略微偏过头，看着那埋头忙着自己事物的少年，只得无奈的摇了摇头，冲着摊贩后的老人歉意一笑，放下手链，再次慵懒的前行性子淡雅的她，很难会主动要求谁给自己买什么东西，即使，是萧炎
前走了不远，有些无聊的薰儿刚想打算回去陪着萧炎，一道清朗的笑声，忽然的从前面传来 。
“咦，这不是薰儿小姐么呵呵，没想到竟然会在此处遇见，真是缘分啊。”
纤细的眉头轻轻一皱，薰儿寻声而望，却是见到一堆人正涌过来，在人群中，众星拱月般的簇拥着一位衣着华贵的青年 。

青年年龄在二十左右，样貌颇为英俊，不过脸色却有些偏白，一双眼眸，此时正带着炽热，牢牢的盯着不远处那亭亭玉立的青春少女，目光中，夹杂着不加掩饰的爱慕。
content_en:
The magic core, on the Dou Qi Continent, is also known as the magic crystal, and the prototype of the elixir, etc. As the name suggests, it is an energy crystal core in the body of Warcraft, which is filled with extremely violent energy of heaven and earth. For this kind of violent energy, even a fighting king would not dare to take the risk of exploding his body and forcibly inhale it.
However, although the magic core cannot be directly absorbed by people, it is an indispensable main material for alchemists when refining medicine. The magic core refined by the alchemist using secret methods will be neutralized by some magical herbs to neutralize the violent attributes, and transform into various strength-enhancing elixirs that countless people covet, and their value will suddenly skyrocket.
Furthermore, magic cores can also be added to weapons. Weapons blessed with magic cores will not only have greater destructive power, but also have the alluring special effect of increasing fighting spirit, making them highly sought after by the fighting class in the mainland.
Of course, in addition to weapons, magic cores can also be added to armor and other items, bringing powerful defense to the owner, giving people a little more life protection when facing danger.
With so many special effects, magic core has undoubtedly become the most popular mainstream material in the Dou Qi Continent. Not only Dou Qi practitioners, but also the distinguished alchemists often travel all over the world to find high-level magic cores to refine higher-level elixirs.
Driven by this trend, magic cores on the mainland are in short supply almost all year round. As soon as high-level magic cores appear at auctions or other places, Lima will be taken away at a high price.
The high cost of magic cores has naturally created a large number of mercenary groups that specialize in hunting and killing magic beasts. However, obtaining magic cores is not an easy task.
First of all, Warcraft are not only powerful, but also extremely cunning. Due to their ferocious nature and special attack methods, Warcraft are often a bit stronger than strong humans of the same level. Therefore, if you want to hunt Warcraft of the same level alone without superior strength, it is easy to steal the chicken but lose the rice.
Secondly, not all monsters have energy crystals like magic cores in their bodies. This seems to be a random probability. Sometimes, when a mercenary group kills a monster with half of the group's casualties, it might end up with nothing. This kind of thing is common in Dou Qi Continent and is not uncommon.
Therefore, the value of magic core in Dou Qi Continent has always been at the top for a long time, and it is extremely popular.
He took Xun'er around a few turns on the spacious streets, and finally entered a medium-sized market located in the south of the city. There are several such medium-sized markets in Wutan City, and they are controlled by the three major families in the city. The market where Xiao Yan came is controlled by the Xiao family.
It is said to be control, but in fact it is better to say that it is to maintain the order and security of the market. As a reward, mercenaries or merchants who set up stalls and trade in the market must pay some commissions to the family. This has always been the rule of the Dou Qi Continent, and it is rare to see anyone making trouble.
Entering from the main gate of Fangshi, there were two guards from the Xiao family at the door. They obviously knew Xiao Yan and the two of them. When they saw their arrival, they were all stunned and then became slightly respectful.
Nodding slightly, Xiao Yan walked straight in, stood by the gate, looked at the endless flow of people inside, and couldn't help but smack his lips. No wonder the family has strict control over the market. The profits brought by this kind of popularity will probably not be small.
"Third Young Master, Miss Xun'er, do you want to buy something when you come to Fangshi?" Just when the two of them were dazzled by the crowd, a respectful voice came from behind.
Hearing the voice, Xiao Yan turned his head. Seven or eight big men wearing the uniform uniforms of the Xiao family were standing behind him. The speaker was a man in his thirties who was leading the group. The man had a badge on his chest. There were six gold stars painted on the badge. Obviously, he was a six-star fighter.Looking at Xiao Yan's confused gaze, the man smiled honestly and said respectfully: "Third Young Master, my name is Pain. I am the captain of the guard appointed by the patriarch himself, specializing in protecting the safety of Fang City. Haha, the young master had his birthday last year, and Pain came to see him."
"Oh, it turns out to be Uncle Payne."
Xiao Yan blinked his eyes. Although he had no impression of this big man, his introduction just now made Xiao Yan smile. Since he was personally appointed by his father, he is naturally his direct subordinate. There should be no problem with his loyalty.
Although the Xiao family is not a super powerful force, the family is also divided into several factions. If the big man in front of him is from other elder factions, then he will not bother to pay attention and just deal with it casually.
"I'm bored in the clan, so I went out for a walk. Uncle Payne, go and do your work. If anything happens, I'll call you." Xiao Yan's childish voice did not have the arrogance of the young master, but was polite and gentle, making people feel comfortable hearing it.
The honorific title of uncle suddenly made the smile on Payne's face thicken a little, and at the same time he became a little more eager. He shook his head, nodded and smiled: "Then, third young master, you can wander around as you like. There are our people everywhere in the city. If anything happens, just call out."
Nodding politely, Xiao Yan pulled Xun'er, got into the crowd, and then disappeared
"Pari, take two people to follow the Third Young Master and warn those golden fingers in the market. Anyone who dares to set their sights on the Third Young Master and Miss Xun'er will stop hanging around here in the future." Looking at the disappearing boy and girl, Payne turned around and shouted softly, and the simplicity on his face turned into a capable one in an instant.
"Yes, captain." A big man nodded solemnly, waved his hand, and led two men into the crowd.
"Haha, the third young master is still so gentle in his treatment of others. It's really comforting." Looking at the three people joining the crowd, Payne smiled, and then sighed with regret: "Such a good young man, what a pity, alas."
Shaking his head regretfully, Payne also led his men to patrol the streets.
Following lazily behind Xiao Yan who was wandering around casually, Xun'er glanced at the crowd of people behind her and said with a faint smile: "Brother Xiao Yan, that Payne is not bad."
Xiao Yan hummed softly and glanced at a vendor next to him. His soul perception was much stronger than ordinary people, so he was also aware of the guards coming behind him. Withdrawing his gaze, Xiao Yan slowed down and walked side by side with the girl next to him. He sniffed the girl's body fragrance as elegant as green lotus, tilted his head and said jokingly: "With the energy of nine levels of fighting, he can sense three guards who are proficient in concealment, Xun'er. It's very unusual."
Xun'er followed Xiao Yan's example, shrugged cutely, and once again used her trump card: smile and silence.
Staring at the girl's silent expression, a warm smile appeared on Xiao Yan's lips. He patted the girl's little head gently with his palm, and in a voice that could only be heard by the two of them, he laughed softly: "Although I don't know exactly who you are and what your background is, I only know that you are my Xiao Yan's sister. No matter what happens in the future, walk faster and move forward.
Xun'er paused in her steps and opened her beautiful big smart eyes, staring at the young man who walked forward gracefully after finishing speaking. After being stunned for a long time, Xun'er finally came back to her senses. The soft smile at the corner of her mouth gradually widened, and finally rendered that delicate little face extremely alluring.
In the bustling market, the girl stands and smiles. Her elegant figure is like a green lotus in the world, elegant and indifferent.
“Sister?
Following Xiao Yan around, he slowly entered the depths of the market. The things sold in the depths of the market are much more precious than those outside, so, you canThe customers who come here to buy can be considered to have some strength in Wutan City.
While Xiao Yan was busy looking for magic crystals, Xun'er also came to a clean stall out of boredom. Yingying stopped, stretched out her fair and delicate wrist, and picked up a light green bracelet. The bracelet was made of ordinary goods, but with some ice silver added to make it feel cold to the touch. It is very suitable for summer wear. Although the material is ordinary, it is also chic and elegant.
After playing around for a while, Xun'er was about to buy, but she remembered that she had lent all the money to Xiao Yan. She turned her head slightly and looked at the young man who was busy with his own things. He shook his head helplessly, smiled apologetically at the old man behind the vendor, put down the bracelet, and walked forward lazily again. With her elegant temperament, it was difficult for her to ask anyone to buy something for herself, even if it was Xiao Yan.
Not far away, Xun'er, who was a little bored, was about to go back to accompany Xiao Yan, when a clear laughter suddenly came from the front.
"Hey, isn't this Miss Xun'er? Haha, I didn't expect to meet you here. What a fate."
Xun'er's slender brows furrowed slightly, and she looked around, only to see a crowd of people coming towards her. In the crowd, a richly dressed young man was surrounded like stars over the moon.
The young man was around 20 years old. He was quite handsome, but his face was a bit pale. His eyes, with fiery eyes, were staring at the slim young girl not far away, with undisguised admiration in his eyes.
